highlights.description: Unified signal ingestion abstraction for operational intelligence following the omnillm architectural pattern
Built-in thick providers for PagerDuty and Jira with SDK-based implementations

added.description: `FetchOptions` for filtering signals by time range, status, severity, and provider-specific filters
`Capabilities` struct describing provider features (streaming, batch fetch, filtering, acknowledge)
Priority-based registration allowing thick providers to override thin providers
PagerDuty incident fetching with pagination, time filtering, status/severity mapping
PagerDuty incident normalization to signal-spec `Signal` type
Jira issue fetching via JQL with project, time, status, priority filters
Jira issue normalization to signal-spec `Signal` type with component entities and label tags

documentation.description: README with overview, quick start, provider table, interface docs, and custom provider guide
MkDocs documentation site with PlexusOne theme
Getting started guides for installation and quickstart
Provider documentation for PagerDuty and Jira

dependencies.description: Add `github.com/plexusone/signal-spec` v0.1.0 for canonical signal types

infrastructure.description: Add shared CI workflows for build, lint, and test
